description: Suite A — empirical regression battery for doi_verify.py, derived from Teste 03 (Fase A.7.2) of the literature-review-academic-ptbr skill. Seven cases from the visible corpus + one synthetic retraction case. Source: ground truth v2.0 of Teste 03, §2; plan canonico §4.2.1.

cases.label: Silva & Lopes 2020 (DOI colidido — Sub-30.2)

expected_metadata.title: A praça como lugar de encontro: sociabilidades e conflitos em espaços públicos centrais de São Paulo

cases.notes: Strong test of Sub-30.2 (fabrication with collided identifier). DOI resolves to a different real article: SILVA, R. A. da. 'Para além do Estado: Marx, Lenin e a crítica da estatalidade', Sociedade e Estado v.35 n.2 p.553-579, 2020. Threshold-blind score on any single field would produce false OK; composite score must drive MISMATCH.

cases.label: Ferreira 2023 (DOI colidido — segundo exemplar Sub-30.2)

expected_metadata.title: Noites paulistanas: mobilidade urbana e a economia do lazer noturno entre jovens trabalhadores

cases.notes: (i) Empirical finding (2026-04-25, Frente 3 §5.2): the DOI 10.1590/2236-9996.2023-5707 resolves in CrossRef and OpenAlex to a real, distinct article — AFONSO, Claudia. 'A dignidade humana impactada por ambientes criados através de ferramentas digitais', Cadernos Metrópole v.25 n.57 p.515-536, 2023. (ii) Composite score observed: 52.2 / 100, with per-field scores authors=27.8, title=42.0, journal=100, year=100, pages=40 — well below the OK threshold (75) and above the trivial-noise floor, the canonical signature of a collided identifier. (iii) Empirical classification: 'fabrication with collided identifier' (Sub-30.2 of references/_changelog.md), analogous to Silva & Lopes 2020 (case 4). The two cases together establish double empirical base for Sub-30.2 within the Teste 03 visible corpus. (iv) This case diverges from ground truth v2.0 of Teste 03 §2.2, which states 'DOI não resolve em CrossRef nem aparece em buscas'. The divergence is registered as pendência arquitetural §(xix) of references/_phase2-handoff.md (revision of ground truth v2.0 of Teste 03 in light of this finding); ground truth v2.0 itself is preserved unchanged as historical record of the 2026-04-25 canonisation state.

cases.label: Magnani 2011 (pastiche stricto sensu, sem DOI)

expected_metadata.title: Juventudes urbanas e circuitos jovens: trajetos e manchas de lazer na metrópole contemporânea

cases.notes: Pastiche stricto sensu (Sub-30.2 categoria pastiche; ground truth v2.0 §2.2). doi_verify.py only sees absence of DOI and returns NO_DOI; pastiche detection is the role of bib_consistency.py + verificação manual via §(xii), not of this script.

cases.label: Wakefield et al. 1998 (caso sintético de retratação)

expected_metadata.title: Ileal-lymphoid-nodular hyperplasia, non-specific colitis, and pervasive developmental disorder in children

cases.notes: Canonical retraction case in health science. Original published in The Lancet, 28 Feb 1998. Formally retracted by The Lancet on 2010-02-02 (Retraction Watch entry: https://retractionwatch.com/2010/02/02/lancet-finally-retracts-andrew-wakefields-fraudulent-mmr-paper/). Choice rationale: (i) DOI is stable and broadly known; (ii) CrossRef registers update-nature='retraction' for the original DOI; (iii) OpenAlex is_retracted=true; (iv) congruence with the public-health domain of the skill, which makes the case directly relevant to the regression battery beyond mere illustration.
